retry.rule: attempt_cap is 1 and retry_classes is empty: there is no second attempt. A run that ends before any gate verdict (crash, quota, timeout: the fetched logs/outcome.json exit_class is refused or crash, with no run/gate-report.json and no GATE PASS or GATE FAIL line in logs/train.log) is not an attempt; it is recorded under pre_verdict_failures and any re-run needs the owner's new approval. A run whose gate executed (exit_class pass or gate_fail, a gate report, or a GATE line) is the attempt even when a file failed to upload. A run whose evidence is missing or inconclusive (no fetch, no outcome.json) is unresolved and is decided by the owner, never counted as not an attempt. A miss is recorded not-reproduced with next_trusted false; nothing after a miss is pre-authorized.
